results.title: Canada Manitoba/Saskatchewan/Alberta wildfires escalation — 12,000 Swan Hills evacuated, 27 active fires MB
results.snippet: Manitoba has 27 active wildfires with 9 out of control. Over 33,000 evacuated across provinces. Swan Hills AB ordered 12,000 to evacuate for fire SWF076 (~2,000ha). 2 fatalities at Lac du Bonnet confirmed.

results.title: NOAA satellites monitor Canadian wildfires and smoke
results.snippet: NOAA GOES and VIIRS tracking massive Canadian wildfire smoke plumes. Multi-satellite observation confirms transatlantic smoke transport.

results.title: CAMS tracks smoke from intense Canadian wildfires reaching Europe
results.snippet: CAMS confirms Canadian wildfire smoke reaching northern Europe. 56Mt carbon release estimated. TROPOMI + OMPS + EarthCare aerosol tracking.

results.title: Canada wildfires: deaths, evacuations in Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Alberta
results.snippet: Two fatalities confirmed. 33,000+ evacuated. Swan Hills AB fire SWF076 out of control, 12,000 ordered to evacuate May 26.

results.title: Santa Rosa Island Fire — 87% containment, mop-up continues
results.snippet: 18,379 acres, 87% contained. Mop-up operations continue. Largest fire in Channel Islands NP history.

results.title: Kilauea Ep48 eruption window opens May 25
results.snippet: Episode 48 forecast window 5/25-26. Inflation continuing but rate slowing. Both vents glowing. SO2 1,000-5,000 t/d. ADVISORY/YELLOW.

results.title: New Eruption in the Bismarck Sea — NASA Earth Observatory
results.snippet: Continuing eruption, thermal anomaly ~7 km², pumice raft 70km² extending 200km+ WSW. Potential new island formation.

results.title: Philippines: back-to-back eruptions — Mayon PDC, Kanlaon explosive eruption
results.snippet: Mayon Alert Level 3, Day 140+, PDC event. Kanlaon Alert Level 2, moderately explosive eruption May 26, ash 2,500m above crater, PDC down eastern slopes.

results.title: Kanlaon Volcano makes explosive eruption, shoots ash plume 2500m
results.snippet: Kanlaon moderately explosive eruption 5/26. Ash plume 2,500m above crater. PDC down eastern slopes. Alert Level 2.

results.title: Bezymianny VAAC advisory #45 — FL100 continuing
results.snippet: Ash plume FL100 (3000m) moving south. Lava dome growing, glowing lava-block avalanches. Previously FL300 (9,100m) on May 20.

results.title: Great Sitkin WATCH/ORANGE — lava dome continuing
results.snippet: Slow lava eruption in summit crater. Small earthquakes. SAR imagery monitoring lava flow advance.

results.title: Shishaldin ADVISORY/YELLOW — SO2 + seismicity
results.snippet: Elevated seismic/infrasound; SO2 emissions; steam plume.

results.title: Dukono VAAC advisory #284+ — FL070 ~190 explosions/day continuing
results.snippet: Alert Level 2. Continuous explosive activity. ~190 explosions per day.

results.title: Satellite images show Persian Gulf oil slicks growing during war — Kharg Island
results.snippet: Oil slick from Kharg Island estimated 3,000+ barrels. 60-70 km² initial slick. Growing during Iran conflict. Sentinel-1 SAR + Sentinel-2 optical + Sentinel-3 ocean color.

results.title: Antelope Reef could now be the largest island in the South China Sea — CSIS AMTI
results.snippet: China: Antelope Reef now 1,490 acres. Philippines: Thitu runway + Nanshan port upgrades (Planet Labs). WorldView/Vantor imagery.

results.title: Iran uses Chinese AI satellite imagery to target US bases in Middle East
results.snippet: Chinese AI startup MizarVision mapping every US military asset in real-time. Iran using for targeting.

results.title: North Korea Yongbyon UEP active — 7th fuel cycle, Sohae expansion, new military factory
results.snippet: 7th fuel irradiation/reprocessing cycle. Consistent water discharge. Sohae solid-fuel test March 2026. New largest military production facility under construction. WorldView-3 imagery.

results.title: Amazon deforestation on pace to be lowest on record — GFW/INPE
results.snippet: Brazil near-real-time alerts show continued decline. GFW DIST-ALERT: Landsat + Sentinel-2 integrated.

results.title: Sentinel-1D fully operational — 4-sat constellation complete
results.snippet: Sentinel-1D declared fully operational May 1. Sentinel-1A/1C/1D all active (1A through June 2026). Revisit period shortened to 4 days.
